name: skills-direct-invocation
description: Verifies the list_skills IPC contract that backs @-mention discovery: the daemon returns a well-formed skills snapshot the chat @-picker reads. The specific @-mention prefetch boost is covered by unit tests in foundation.rs (it runs on the LLM-driven prompt path, which is not offline-safe), and the trusted-root scan is verified live. This scenario stays environment-agnostic because an isolated runtime root has an empty skills catalog by design.
